userdoc.notice: OptFormsVault — seat EX-12 (arc3-loop1-round6, c2 chain). Independent Vyper 0.4.3 carrier for byte-characterizing the non-default optimizer forms named as an Unknown in corpus/knowledge/2026-10-19-arc3-r4-evm-vyper-leg.md:28: `--no-optimize`, `-O none`, `-O codesize` (plus the default `-O gas` baseline on the same source). Function set deliberately differs from r4's CarrierV (13 ABI functions, 5 public getters + 8 explicit externals, one payable default, zero ERC-20 selectors) so the selector set and bucket count are independent.
